## RangeProportionInitializer_004a1fd0 — RangeProportionInitializer

**Summary:** Initializes a float range min/max pair and precomputes inverse range for proportion calculation. Sets field 0/2/4 to min, max, and (if range positive) 1/(max-min) for fast linear interpolation lookups.

**Frame-path:** ON_FRAME_PATH  
**Call frequency:** per-frame tick

**Called by:** sub_4A35F0 (004a35f0), PhysicsChannelProcessingWithLocals (004a3820), PitCrewAnimationMASSetup (004a3910), sub_4D0110 (004d0110)

**Struct fields accessed:**

| Base | Offset | R/W | Init (literal → value) | Purpose |
|------|--------|-----|------------------------|---------|
| this | 0x0 | RW | — | Range minimum value (a2) |
| this | 0x4 | RW | — | Range maximum value (a3) |
| this | 0x8 | RW | — | Inverse range (1/(max-min) or 0 if range <= 0) |

**Written-by note (persistence):**
- this 0x0: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist
- this 0x4: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist
- this 0x8: recalc every frame — external poke does NOT persist

**Globals referenced:**

| Address | Name | R/W | Role |
|---------|------|-----|------|
| 0059e43c | flt_59E43C | R | physics constant [DERIVED] (also: ` — float threshold for contact aging overflow) |
| 0059e440 | flt_59E440 | R | ZeroThreshold (~0.0f, physics clamp) [DERIVED] |

**Functions called:**

| Address | Name | Purpose |
|---------|------|---------|

**Guard conditions:** Range check: if (max - min) <= 0, set inverse to 0 (prevents division by zero). Otherwise set inverse to 1/(max-min).
